mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules (calendar_id, google_event_id, title, description, location, start_time, end_time, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{calendarId}, #{googleEventId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_id, google_event_id, title, description, location, start_time, end_time, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM schedules WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, location = #{location}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
